title: Prefixed Motion Verbs
intro: Russian motion verbs gain precise directional meanings when prefixes are added. The unidirectional base (идти) becomes perfective with prefixes (войти, выйти, прийти), while the multidirectional base (ходить) becomes imperfective (входить, выходить, приходить). Key prefixes: в-/во- (into), вы- (out), при- (arrive), у- (leave/depart), под- (approach), от- (move away), за- (drop by), пере- (cross), про- (pass through). Each prefixed pair forms an aspect pair: выйти (pf) / выходить (impf) - to exit.
rules: Unidirectional base + prefix = PERFECTIVE: идти → войти, выйти, прийти, уйти (single completed motion)
Multidirectional base + prefix = IMPERFECTIVE: ходить → входить, выходить, приходить, уходить (repeated or process)
в-/во- = into: войти (enter on foot), въехать (drive in), внести (bring in)
вы- = out: выйти (exit), выехать (drive out), вынести (take out)
examples: Он вошёл в комнату. (He entered the room., perfective), single action
Она часто выходит на балкон. (She often goes out to the balcony., imperfective), repeated
Автобус приехал вовремя. (The bus arrived on time., perfective), completed arrival
Мы уходим в пять часов. (We're leaving at five., imperfective), process

items.prompt: Она _____ в магазин и купила хлеб. (She entered the store and bought bread.)
items.promptEnglish: She entered the store and bought bread.
items.hint: в- = into. Single completed action of entering → perfective

items.prompt: Поезд _____ со станции в 10 часов. (The train departs from the station at 10.)
items.hint: от- = away from. Scheduled departure (present for future) → imperfective

items.prompt: Гости уже _____? (Have the guests already arrived?)
items.hint: при- = arrive. Asking about completed arrival → perfective

items.prompt: Каждое утро он _____ из дома в 8 часов. (Every morning he leaves home at 8.)
items.promptEnglish: Every morning he leaves home at 8.
items.hint: вы- = out. Repeated action (каждое утро) → imperfective

items.prompt: Я _____ к окну и посмотрел на улицу. (I went up to the window and looked at the street.)
items.promptEnglish: I went up to the window and looked at the street.
items.hint: под- = approach. Single completed approach → perfective

items.prompt: Мама _____ на работу каждый день на автобусе. (Mom goes to work by bus every day.)
items.promptEnglish: Mom goes to work by bus every day.
items.hint: у- = depart/leave. Daily routine → imperfective departure

items.prompt: Мы _____ через парк и вышли на главную улицу. (We crossed through the park and came out on the main street.)
items.hint: про- = through/past. Completed passage through → perfective

items.prompt: По дороге домой я _____ в аптеку. (On the way home I dropped by the pharmacy.)
items.promptEnglish: I dropped by the pharmacy on the way home.
items.hint: за- = drop by/stop in. Single brief visit → perfective

items.prompt: Они _____ в новую квартиру на прошлой неделе. (They moved to a new apartment last week.)
items.promptEnglish: They moved to a new apartment last week.

blanks: Когда ты _____? — Через час. (When are you leaving? — In an hour.)
Вчера он _____ из дома в семь утра. (Yesterday he left the house at seven.)
Машина часто _____ во двор. (The car often drives into the yard.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Prefix у- = departure; вы- = exit; в- = entry
hints: у- means departure. Near-future planned departure — which form?
вы- means exiting. Single completed exit yesterday. Which form?
в- means entering. Repeated habitual action — which form?
explanations: Planned departure uses imperfective present: уходишь (you are leaving).
Single completed past action uses perfective: вышел (he went out).
Repeated habitual action uses imperfective: въезжает (drives in regularly).

minimalPairs.explanation: Single completed entry uses perfective: вошёл.

minimalPairs.context: Пока она _____ в комнату, телефон зазвонил. (was entering)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: While she was entering the room, the phone rang.
minimalPairs.explanation: Action in progress uses imperfective: входила.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: What direction does the prefix indicate?

reviewVocab.example: Он вошёл. Она входит каждый день.
